summary:
Outlook’s web mail is outlook.live.com. The blue “O” envelope is the icon people look up, separate from the Microsoft four-square logo. If that host does not return an image, the page is omitted.

Checked 12 November 2026 against outlook.live.com. HTML came from https://outlook.live.com/mail/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: shortcut icon → https://outlook.live.com/mail/favicon.ico; apple-touch-icon → https://res.public.onecdn.static.microsoft/assets/mail/pwa/v4/pngs/apple-touch-icon.png.

The favicon.ico URL is https://outlook.live.com/mail/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 9622 bytes. Directory sizes: 32×32, 24×24, 20×20, 16×16.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://res.public.onecdn.static.microsoft/assets/mail/pwa/v4/pngs/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 180×180 png.

Brand colour #1144bb comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-180x180-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-180x180-01.png at 180×180 (png, 15472 bytes) from https://res.public.onecdn.static.microsoft/assets/mail/pwa/v4/pngs/apple-touch-icon.png.
